name: Quality Switch Inc
old_description: Quality Switch is a manufacturer of a wide variety of de-energized tap changers and electrical switches used primarily in transformers and load centers, but can be applied wherever power is controlled. The current company executive director, Larry Dix, came to Quality Switch in 1995 with a background as an engineer in the transformer industry. He shifted the focus of the company to engineering and design in addition to manufacturing. The majority of the switch designs are backed by independent or in-house testing. These include short circuit tests, impulse tests, applied voltage tests, mechanical endurance tests and various other tests on basic switch designs. Periodically, we retest designs and materials to verify compliance with original tests.
about:
Quality Switch Inc operates from Newton Falls, Ohio. The company's current executive director, Larry Dix, joined in 1995 after a career as an engineer in the transformer industry and redirected the business toward engineering and design alongside manufacturing. The firm has been recognized as a family-owned business by the Regional Chamber.

The company produces de-energized tap changers and electrical switches primarily for transformers and load centers. Its capabilities span engineering, design, and manufacturing, backed by a testing program that includes short-circuit, impulse, applied-voltage, and mechanical-endurance evaluations. A quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 is maintained, and several employees hold statistical quality control certifications from Kent State University.

Quality Switch serves the electrical equipment sector, focusing on transformer and load-center manufacturers that require customized switching solutions. The company emphasizes tailored integration of its products into customers' designs.

The company differentiates itself through a commitment to rigorous testing, periodic retesting of designs and materials, and a responsible-sourcing policy for conflict minerals. Its quality program has evolved from ISO 9001:1994 to the current 2015 standard.

name: Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures LLC
old_description: Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures is owned and operated by Frank Carrion, who has over 35 years of experience in Architectural Woodworking, Architectural Metalwork, Cabinetry, Millwork, Trade Show Exhibits and Store Fixtures. Frank and his team take their time with each project and work solely to achieve each client’s complete satisfaction.  No project is too big or too small for Frank to take on.   Not only does he have the experience, but he has the eye for this industry.  His attention to detail is stellar and his own expectations exceed what is being asked of him.  He initially founded MCA Woodworkers, Inc., a successful Long Island based company in 2004.  When new opportunity arose, he moved to Virginia to work as Director of Production for Premier Store Fixtures.  He was extremely successful in this position for five years but he yearned to open his own company again.
about:
Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures was founded in 2018 by Frank Carrion in Ashland, Virginia. Carrion, who brings over 35 years of experience in architectural woodworking, metalwork, cabinetry, and millwork, previously founded MCA Woodworkers Inc. on Long Island in 2004. After serving five years as director of production for Store Fixtures, he returned to business ownership to establish the current shop. The company operates as a sole proprietorship under Carrion’s leadership.

The shop specializes in custom architectural woodwork and millwork, including cabinetry, kitchens, residential furniture, store fixtures, and architectural metalwork. It also produces trade show exhibits. All work is performed on a project basis, with no stated facility size, headcount, or annual volume disclosed.

The company serves clients in retail, residential construction, trade show marketing, and general architectural millwork. Concrete examples from its service list include custom store fixtures for retail environments, cabinetry and furniture for residential projects, and exhibit fabrication for trade shows.

Carrion started the business to apply his exacting standards and “old-fashioned values” to every project, regardless of size. The firm emphasizes that “can’t is not in our vocabulary” and pledges to exceed client expectations through attention to detail and a willingness to tackle any scope.

name: R. Stahl Inc.
old_description: R. Stahl manufactures lockable load and motor switchgear made from glass-fiber reinforced polyester. Switchgear operates up to 690 VAC and is rated for -20°C to +40°C ambient, providing corrosion-resistant protection (IP65) for industrial applications.
about:
R. Stahl Inc. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company employs over 1,000 people and operates as a manufacturer of explosion-protected electrical and electronic products for hazardous and harsh industrial environments.

The company produces a broad range of switchgear and control equipment, including lockable load switchgear, motor switchgear, and control cabinets made from glass-fiber reinforced polyester. Its portfolio extends to control stations, circuit breaker assemblies, disconnect and transfer switches, plugs and receptacles, empty enclosures for hazardous and harsh areas, intrinsically safe isolators and barriers, remote I/O systems, terminal junction boxes, HMIs, and power distribution systems. These products are designed using protection methods such as intrinsic safety, explosion proof, encapsulation, non incendive, and purge and pressurization, and are rated for NEC Class I, II, Division 1 and 2 as well as CEC Zone classifications.

R. Stahl serves customers in the food and beverage, electronics, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries, along with other industrial facilities that require corrosion-resistant, IP65-rated equipment capable of operating from -20°C to +40°C at up to 690 VAC.

The company emphasizes its specialization in extreme environments, offering products with wide temperature ranges, corrosion-resistant materials, and extreme durability. Its core program highlights round-the-clock orderability, attractive pricing, fast delivery, and versatility as key differentiators.

old_description: PRESS RELEASE Manchester, N.H. (USA) – RCD Components, a premier manufacturer of resistors and other passive components for the global electronics community, announces the unveiling of its new brand identity with a redesigned logo and a revamped website. The rebrand
about:
RCD Components was founded in 1973 in Manchester, New Hampshire, where it remains headquartered. The company was acquired by Gowanda Components Group in 2019 and became part of the iNRCORE Group in 2020, expanding its portfolio within a broader passive-components manufacturer network.

The company designs, manufactures, and tests precision mission-critical resistors — including wirewound, high-surge, carbon-composition, and custom configurations — as well as inductor products. RCD operates a U.S.-based production facility that added a new laboratory and expanded capacity in 2026, supporting high-volume standard and custom orders with an extensive datasheet library for every listed part.

RCD serves space, aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial markets, supplying engineers and procurement teams at organizations where component failure is not an option. Its resistors are used in satellites, launch systems, radar, communications, missile systems, medical equipment, and industrial automation.

RCD differentiates itself by focusing exclusively on resistors, providing direct access to design engineers, and maintaining a zero-defect culture backed by ISO 9001 certification and ITAR compliance. The company advertises lead times up to three times shorter than competing high-reliability resistor manufacturers, with a SWIFT delivery service that can ship components in as little as three days.

name: RadScan Medical Equipment, Inc.
old_description: For over 30 years RadScan Medical Equipment has been a market-leading medical device accessory company that develops and manufactures a wide range of high quality products and accessories for various medical devices that help you safeguard and maintain your sensitive medical equipment as well as prioritizing the safety of your staff and patients.
about:
RadScan Medical Equipment, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Phoenix, Arizona, by a biomedical engineer who encountered CT scanner downtime caused by contaminants seeping under the cradle into the table interior. With CDC regulations highlighting risks of HIV and hepatitis C exposure during maintenance, he developed a preventive solution: the first CT Slicker® protective cover, which was patented and became the foundation of the company.

Today RadScan develops and manufactures a broad line of medical device accessories, including Slicker® protective covers and cushion table pads for CT, angiography, nuclear medicine, and cardiac catheterization tables. The company operates a 15,000‑square‑foot FDA‑registered and ISO 13485‑certified facility where it performs RF welding and sealing of thermoplastics (polyethylene, polypropylene, PVC, polyurethane, ABS), foam fabrication, industrial sewing, CNC precision cutting, and full product assembly. RadScan reports serving more than 40 countries, 1,600 customers, and offering over 100 imaging products.

The customer base spans original equipment manufacturers, hospitals, clinics, and a global network of dealers and distributors. RadScan partners with OEMs to co‑design new imaging accessories and also sells its branded covers and pads directly to healthcare facilities worldwide.

The company emphasizes its regulatory expertise — maintaining ISO 13485, FDA, EU MDR, RoHS, and REACH compliance — and its American‑made manufacturing as key differentiators. Its design‑to‑production capability allows it to take a concept through regulatory clearance to volume production, a service it promotes to OEMs seeking a single‑source partner.

Customers loved the lint-free, cotton fabric and began cutting out and hemming towels for everyday use. Ben noticed the trend and demand which inspired him to start manufacturing the World’s Finest Flour Sack Towels™ along with flour sacks.
about:
Rapid Packaging is headquartered in Champlin, Minnesota, and was founded in 1988. The company's lineage traces back to 1943 when Ben Berg established Berg Bag Company in Minneapolis to supply flour sacks to area mills, later expanding into manufacturing lint‑free flour sack towels.

Today Rapid Packaging operates as a packaging solutions distributor and service provider. Its product portfolio spans custom corrugated boxes, FIBC bulk bags, industrial bags (BOPP, polyethylene, woven polypropylene, textile), protective packaging, shrink and stretch films, tapes, and void fill. The firm also supplies end‑of‑line automation equipment — auto baggers, case erectors, case sealers, conveyors, palletizers, shrink wrap systems — and backs them with parts, service, equipment financing, and used‑equipment rentals.

The company serves industrial manufacturers, food processors, agricultural operations, and e‑commerce fulfillment centers that need practical packaging to reduce cost, labor, and time. Typical customers include businesses requiring sandbags, FIBCs for bulk handling, and custom corrugated packaging for shipping.

Rapid Packaging differentiates itself through its "Core7" strategic product categories chosen by industry experts, local inventory access with maintained pricing, and a "Partner with Local Supplier" model. It highlights sustainability partnerships with suppliers such as Pregis, IPG, and 3M, and cites over 150 years of combined experience in packaging optimization.

Rooted in our founder's values, we serve lumber dealers throughout Oklahoma with a diverse product range and exceptional service. Join us as we build a stronger future together.
about:
Ray Albright Steel Products has operated from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma since 1974. The family‑owned business was founded by Ray Albright and has served the state’s lumber dealers and construction trades for over five decades.

The company stocks and supplies a broad range of building materials including structural steel, rebar and concrete accessories, roofing products, sheet metal and HVAC duct components, as well as specialty items such as steel banding, anchor bolts, ornamental iron and polyfilm. It operates a delivery fleet that runs daily across Oklahoma, allowing same‑day or next‑day shipment on stocked items and quick turnaround on special orders. No minimum order size is enforced.

Primary customers are lumber yards, residential and commercial contractors, HVAC installers and roofing crews throughout Oklahoma. The firm also works with retail customers on backyard projects, emphasizing that no job is too small.

The company cites its family ownership, fifty‑plus years of local presence, bilingual (English/Spanish) service, competitive pricing and a “no order too small” policy as the reasons customers return.

name: ReVision Energy
old_description: Founded in 2003, ReVision Energy is a 100% employee-owned solar company in Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts. We’re on a mission to make life better by building our just and equitable electric future, and we’re rewriting the way solar business is done.
about:
ReVision Energy is headquartered in North Andover, Massachusetts, with operations across Maine, New Hampshire, and Massachusetts. Founded in 2003 by Bill Behrens as EnergyWorks, the renewable energy division of the Green Store in Belfast, Maine, the company expanded in 2005 when Fortunat Mueller and Phil Coupe launched Renewable Energy Contractors. The two entities merged in 2008 to form ReVision Energy, and the business converted to a 100% employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) in 2017.

The company designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, heat pumps, and electric vehicle charging stations for residential and commercial customers, and provides ongoing service and maintenance.

ReVision Energy serves homeowners, businesses, municipalities, schools, and non‑profits throughout New England. Notable projects include the Keene Housing affordable‑housing solar array, the Hooksett landfill solar installation for town and school energy savings, and the Small Business Solar Accelerator program for local enterprises.

The company was founded to make life better by building a just and equitable electric future. Its 100% employee‑owned structure and Certified B Corporation status reflect a commitment to using business as a force for good, prioritizing people over profit and fostering an ownership mindset among all staff.

old_description: Our highly experienced Reading Truck team in Salt Lake City has the knowledge you need to deliver the work truck you want. Specializing in custom fabrication – from ladder racks to bed modifications and more – we provide competitive quotes and have extensive inventory from top quality vendors, saving you time and money.
about:
Reading Truck operates a full-service upfitting and repair center at 4285 West 1385 South in Salt Lake City, Utah. The location is part of a national network of Reading Truck centers and authorized distributors, providing local service backed by a broader organization.

The facility specializes in commercial truck and van upfitting, including service body installations, custom van configurations, ladder racks, toolboxes, and specialized compartments. Technicians handle custom fabrication, bed modifications, and fleet maintenance programs ranging from preventive maintenance to emergency repairs. The shop also offers mobile field service, crane and liftgate inspections, DOT compliance work, and ASME R-Stamp certified tank testing. A retail store, showroom, and parts counter stock air compressors, cargo control, lighting, trailers, and replacement parts from manufacturers.

Customers span construction, HVAC, telecommunications, utilities, and landscaping sectors, as well as fleet managers overseeing vehicles from Sprinter vans to semi-trailers, flatbeds, dump bodies, garbage trucks, and snowplows.

The company emphasizes a one-year warranty on upfitting work, premium materials suited to Utah’s climate extremes, and the convenience of a national support network for customers whose work travels beyond the region.

name: Ready Cable Inc. - Post Tension, Rebar, & Lumber
old_description: Ready Cable Inc. was founded in 1988 with the goal of providing quality products, excellent customer service, quick turn around, and the best value pricing to concrete contractors. Over the years the business has grown to supply and service both the residential and commercial construction community, catering to projects as small as paving and to projects as large as high-rise buildings.
about:
Ready Cable Inc. is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, and was founded in 1988 by Robert “Bob” Lemke and his wife, Virginia “Jenny” Lemke. The couple’s roots in concrete go back to 1972, when they started Lemke Concrete in Illinois. After harsh winters prompted a move to Dallas in 1984, they identified a market gap for post‑tension cable materials and services and launched Ready Cable Inc. four years later. The business remains family‑owned and operates multiple yards across the Dallas‑Fort Worth metroplex, Greater Houston, Austin and San Antonio.

The company manufactures and supplies post‑tension cables, reinforcing steel (rebar) and lumber for concrete reinforcement. Its service side includes estimation and detailing for conventional and post‑tension slabs, jobsite delivery of foundation packages, professional stressing of post‑tension systems, and repair of those systems. The operation serves both residential and commercial projects, from driveway paving to high‑rise foundations.

Customers are primarily concrete contractors and builders in the residential and commercial construction sectors. Ready Cable’s packages have been used on projects ranging from single‑family home slabs to multi‑story commercial towers throughout Texas. The firm also works with its sister company, Nortex Foundation Design, which provides engineered foundation plans when clients lack shop drawings.

The Lemkes started Ready Cable to control the quality and availability of post‑tension materials for their own contracting work, a mission that evolved into a broader commitment to quick turnaround, competitive pricing and reliable field support for other contractors.
